items.informal_name: Infimum degree of an element in the additive monoid algebra
items.type:
{R : Type u_1} →
  {A : Type u_3} →
    {T : Type u_4} →
      [inst : Semiring R] → [inst_1 : SemilatticeInf T] → [OrderTop T] → (A → T) → AddMonoidAlgebra R A → T
items.informal_description: For an element $ f $ in the additive monoid algebra $ R[A] $, this function computes the infimum (greatest lower bound) of the degrees of the elements in its support, where the support consists of the non-zero terms of $ f $. The infimum is taken with respect to the degree ordering $ D $ on the additive monoid $ A $, starting from the top element and iteratively combining with the degrees of each term in the support.

items.informal_name: Vanishing of coefficients outside the supremum degree in additive monoid algebras
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_3} {B : Type u_5} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : SemilatticeSup B] [inst_2 : OrderBot B]
  {D : A → B} {p : AddMonoidAlgebra R A} {a : A}, ¬D a ≤ AddMonoidAlgebra.supDegree D p → p a = 0
items.informal_description: For any element $ p \in R[A] $ in an additive monoid algebra over a semiring $ R $, and for any $ a \in A $, if the degree $ D(a) $ is not less than or equal to the supremum degree $ \sup\{D(b) \mid b \in \text{supp}(p)\} $ of $ p $, then the coefficient $ p(a) $ is zero. Here, $ \text{supp}(p) $ denotes the support of $ p $, i.e., the set of $ b \in A $ where $ p(b) \neq 0 $.

items.informal_name: Infimum Degree Inequality in Additive Monoid Algebra Product
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_3} {T : Type u_4} {ι : Type u_6} [inst : SemilatticeInf T] [inst_1 : OrderTop T]
  [inst_2 : CommSemiring R] [inst_3 : AddCommMonoid A] [inst_4 : AddCommMonoid T] [AddLeftMono T] [AddRightMono T]
  {degt : A → T},
  0 ≤ degt 0 →
    (∀ (a b : A), degt a + degt b ≤ degt (a + b)) →
      ∀ (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → AddMonoidAlgebra R A), ∑ i ∈ s, (f i).support.inf degt ≤ (∏ i ∈ s, f i).support.inf degt
items.informal_description: For a commutative semiring $ R $ and an additive commutative monoid $ A $, let $ \text{degt} : A \to \mathbb{R} $ satisfy $ \text{degt}(0) \geq 0 $ and $ \text{degt}(a + b) \geq \text{degt}(a) + \text{degt}(b) $. For any finite set $ s $ and function $ f : s \to R[A] $, the sum of the infima of $ \text{degt} $ over the supports of each $ f(i) $ is less than or equal to the infimum of $ \text{degt} $ over the support of the product $ \prod_{i \in s} f(i) $.

items.informal_name: Lower bound on degree of support under exponentiation in additive monoid algebra
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_3} {T : Type u_4} [inst : SemilatticeInf T] [inst_1 : OrderTop T] [inst_2 : Semiring R]
  [inst_3 : AddMonoid A] [inst_4 : AddMonoid T] [AddLeftMono T] [AddRightMono T] {degt : A → T},
  0 ≤ degt 0 →
    (∀ (a b : A), degt a + degt b ≤ degt (a + b)) →
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (f : AddMonoidAlgebra R A), n • f.support.inf degt ≤ (f ^ n).support.inf degt
items.informal_description: Let $ R $ be a semiring and $ A $ an additive monoid. For any function $ \deg : A \to \mathbb{R} $ satisfying $ \deg(0) \geq 0 $ and $ \deg(a + b) \geq \deg(a) + \deg(b) $ for all $ a, b \in A $, and for any $ f \in R[A] $ and $ n \in \mathbb{N} $, the inequality $ n \cdot \inf_{a \in \text{supp}(f)} \deg(a) \leq \inf_{a \in \text{supp}(f^n)} \deg(a) $ holds, where $ \text{supp}(f) $ denotes the support of $ f $.

items.informal_name: Inequality for Infimum of Degrees in Additive Monoid Algebra
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_3} {T : Type u_4} [inst : SemilatticeInf T] [inst_1 : OrderTop T] [inst_2 : Semiring R]
  [inst_3 : AddMonoid A] [inst_4 : AddMonoid T] [AddLeftMono T] [AddRightMono T] {degt : A → T},
  0 ≤ degt 0 →
    (∀ (a b : A), degt a + degt b ≤ degt (a + b)) →
      ∀ (l : List (AddMonoidAlgebra R A)), (List.map (fun f => f.support.inf degt) l).sum ≤ l.prod.support.inf degt
items.informal_description: Given a degree function $\text{degt}$ on an additive monoid algebra $R[A]$ satisfying $\text{degt}(0) \geq 0$ and $\text{degt}(a) + \text{degt}(b) \leq \text{degt}(a + b)$ for all $a, b \in A$, and a list $l$ of elements in $R[A]$, the sum of the infima of $\text{degt}$ over the supports of each element in $l$ is less than or equal to the infimum of $\text{degt}$ over the support of the product of all elements in $l$.

items.informal_name: Infimum Degree Subadditivity in Additive Monoid Algebra
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_3} {T : Type u_4} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : SemilatticeInf T] [inst_2 : OrderTop T]
  (D : A → T) (f g : AddMonoidAlgebra R A),
  AddMonoidAlgebra.infDegree D f ⊓ AddMonoidAlgebra.infDegree D g ≤ AddMonoidAlgebra.infDegree D (f + g)
items.informal_description: For any two elements $f$ and $g$ in the additive monoid algebra $R[A]$, the infimum of their individual infimum degrees with respect to a degree ordering $D$ satisfies $\inf(\deg(f), \deg(g)) \leq \deg(f + g)$, where $\deg(-)$ denotes the infimum degree function.

items.informal_name: Supremum Degree Equals Maximum under Degree Function
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_3} {B : Type u_5} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : SemilatticeSup B] [inst_2 : OrderBot B]
  {D : A → B} [inst_3 : AddZeroClass A] {p : AddMonoidAlgebra R A} {b : B},
  b ∈ Set.range D → Function.invFun D b ∈ p.support → (∀ a ∈ p.support, D a ≤ b) → AddMonoidAlgebra.supDegree D p = b
items.informal_description: If $ b $ is in the range of the degree function $ D $, the preimage $ D^{-1}(b) $ is in the support of $ p $, and $ b $ is an upper bound for $ D(a) $ for all $ a $ in the support of $ p $, then the supremum degree of $ p $ with respect to $ D $ is equal to $ b $. Formally, $ \supDegree_D(p) = b $.

items.informal_name: Infimum Degree of Product is at Least Sum of Infimum Degrees in Additive Monoid Algebra
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} {A : Type u_3} {T : Type u_4} [inst : Semiring R] [inst_1 : SemilatticeInf T] [inst_2 : OrderTop T]
  [inst_3 : AddZeroClass A] [inst_4 : Add T] [AddLeftMono T] [AddRightMono T] (D : A →ₙ+ T)
  (f g : AddMonoidAlgebra R A),
  AddMonoidAlgebra.infDegree (⇑D) f + AddMonoidAlgebra.infDegree (⇑D) g ≤ AddMonoidAlgebra.infDegree (⇑D) (f * g)
items.informal_description: Let $ R $ be a semiring, $ A $ an additive monoid, and $ T $ an ordered additive monoid with a degree function $ D : A \to T $. For any $ f, g \in R[A] $, the infimum degree of the product $ f \cdot g $ satisfies $ \inf\text{deg}(f \cdot g) \geq \inf\text{deg}(f) + \inf\text{deg}(g) $, where $ \inf\text{deg} $ denotes the infimum of the degrees of the support elements.
